notes.content: Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at: http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html

notes.content: The Astronomy major with a B.A. degree in liberal arts and sciences requires competency (successfully completing the third college semester or fifth college quarter) in one foreign language to fulfill graduation requirements; the B.S. degree in applied arts and sciences does not.
